---
title: "A framework to investigate trophic reorganization in marine systems using predator stomach contents"
subtitle: "Figures"
format:
  docx:
    fig-width: 6.5
    fig-cap-location: bottom
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      dpi = 300, out.width = "100%")
DIRS <- c("Output_Figures", "Output_Appendices", "Output_Figures_extra")

# Finds a figure by filename pattern across DIRS. Stops if nothing matches, and
# warns if several files match, so that a stale copy is never picked silently.
fig <- function(pattern) {
  hits <- list.files(DIRS, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (!length(hits)) stop("introuvable : ", pattern, call. = FALSE)
  if (length(hits) > 1)
    warning("plusieurs fichiers pour '", pattern, "' : ",
            paste(basename(hits), collapse = ", "), " -- premier retenu",
            call. = FALSE)
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(hits[1]))
}
```

fig("^Fig1_study_area")

# Robustness of the diagnostic assignment

```{r fs8, fig.cap="Figure S8. Calibration of the three tests under a permutation null. Period labels were permuted among trawl sets within each cell of the between-period contrast (2004–2006 vs 2018–2019), preserving the number of sets per period, so that no between-period difference exists by construction; the rejection rate at α = 0.05 is the empirical false-positive rate of each test. Rates are shown by class of sample size (the smaller of the two per-period set counts), from 200 permutations over ten prey resolutions at the Gulf-wide scale. Dashed line: nominal 5%."}
fig("^FigS8_null_calibration")
```

```{r fs9, fig.cap="Figure S9. Frequency of the four diagnostic families under the nominal significance threshold (α = 0.05 for all three tests, grey) and under thresholds calibrated on the permutation null of Figure S8 (blue; α = 0.014 in biomass and 0.030 in occurrence for the diversity test). Gulf-wide scale, means across the 100 prey resolutions."}
fig("^FigS9_calibrated_thresholds")
```

```{r fs10, fig.cap="Figure S10. Family frequencies under equalized sampling effort, Gulf-wide scale. Each cell of each contrast was capped at the smallest per-period number of trawl sets observed among the within-period contrasts of that cell, sets were drawn without replacement, and the analysis repeated over independent draws. Boxes: distribution across draws; crosses: values from the full, unbalanced data. Cells whose target fell below three sets or that were absent from any contrast were excluded (14 of 65)."}
fig("^FigS10_balanced_effort_gulf")
```

```{r fs11, fig.cap="Figure S11. As Figure S10, ecoregion scale. At this scale two thirds of cells were excluded (132 of 200), most because they were absent from at least one contrast, and the median target was six sets per period; the figure is reported for completeness and is interpreted in the text with these restrictions."}
fig("^FigS11_balanced_effort_ecoregion")
```
